module.purpose: Shim module that adapts the react-noop-renderer host config to the react-reconciler's expected module-shaped host config interface by re-exporting and binding values from an injected $$$config argument.
module.summary: This module serves as a bridge between the react-reconciler bundle (which expects host config as static module exports) and the react-noop-renderer (which receives config as a function argument). It re-exports all symbols from the noop renderer's config and defines opaque Flow types plus a large set of constant exports that read from the $$$config object supplied by the reconciler's wrapping function. The file contains no logic, only type declarations and bindings grouped into sections for microtasks, test selectors, mutation, persistence, hydration, resources, and singletons.
module.businessContext: Internal React testing/renderer infrastructure. Failure breaks the react-noop-renderer and reconciler test suites, blocking concurrent feature validation.
systemCapabilities: bind injected config to module exports

sectionMap.name: core-config
sectionMap.intent: Re-export noop config and define base opaque types

sectionMap.name: test-selectors
sectionMap.intent: Bind optional test selector host config

invariants.description: $$$config must be provided by the wrapping function in the reconciler bundle before module bindings are evaluated

assumptions.description: The react-reconciler bundle wraps this module in a function that supplies $$$config as argument
All exported consts depend on $$$config being already initialized at module load

concurrencyModel.notes: Module-level constant bindings only; no async or concurrency primitives.

moduleLayout: export const host config function bindings (getPublicInstance ... bindToConsole)
